verdict.rationale: Warp's marketing describes a first-party Warp Agent that handles onboarding, payroll, tax notices and benefits, and asks the user when a decision is theirs. It also says Warp can be used from Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients, which implies conversational operation of the product. However, no evidence explicitly documents natural-language command input, its scope, or how it works. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, depth and coverage of agent-operable actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits. It asks when a decision is yours, and records every action it takes.
Use Warp from the agents your team already runs. Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP.
